Unless stated otherwise, the rights belong to Nihiramusic Entertainment LLP, Nihira Joshi or the respective rights holders (for example record labels, film producers and photographers). Privacy Policy
*Last updated: 1 November 2026*
1. Who is responsible

Nihiramusic Entertainment LLP, 2, Jadhav House, Sulabha Niwas, Junction of Lt. Dilip Gupte Road and Pt. Gunidas Marg, Mahim, Mumbai 400016, India, e-mail contact@nihiramusic.in, is responsible for this website ("controller" under the EU General Data Protection Regulation, GDPR, and "data fiduciary" under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023).
2. In short

items: No cookies, no analytics, no advertising, no tracking.
No forms, no user accounts, no newsletter, no payments.
Fonts, images and video preview pictures are served from this website itself.
YouTube videos load only after you click play.
If you write to us by e-mail, we use your message only to answer it.

blocks.text: 3. Hosting (GitHub Pages)

This website is hosted by GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you open a page, your browser sends the technical data every web server receives: IP address, date and time, the page requested, referring page, browser and operating system. According to GitHub, the IP address of visitors to GitHub Pages sites is logged and stored for security purposes. We have no access to these logs and do not use them. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR (our legitimate interest in a secure and reliable website). Details: GitHub Privacy Statement, https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement
4. YouTube videos

Videos are embedded in "click to play" mode. Until you click, only a preview picture stored on this website is shown and no connection to YouTube is made. When you press play, the video loads from youtube-nocookie.com, a service operated for users in the EU by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland, and otherwise by Google LLC, USA. YouTube then receives at least your IP address and the address of this page, and may use cookies or similar technologies as described in Google's Privacy Policy, https://policies.google.com/privacy. Legal basis: your consent by clicking play (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR). If you do not want this, do not start the video, or watch it on YouTube directly.
5. Calendar

"Add to calendar" creates a calendar file in your browser; nothing is sent to us. The "Google Calendar" and "Subscribe" links open Google Calendar or your own calendar app; from then on, that provider's privacy policy applies.
6. Links to other websites
Links to streaming services, social networks and press articles open those websites. They are contacted only when you click a link, and their own privacy policies apply.
7. E-mail

If you write to contact@nihiramusic.in, we process your e-mail address, your name and your message to answer you (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR where it concerns a booking or other agreement, otherwise Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). We delete them when they are no longer needed, unless the law requires us to keep them. Our mailboxes are run by an e-mail hosting provider on our behalf.
8. Processing outside the EU and India
GitHub and Google may process data in the USA and other countries. Information about the safeguards they use is in their privacy statements linked above.
9. Your rights

Under the GDPR you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, and you may withdraw a consent at any time with effect for the future. You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may ask for a summary of your personal data we process, its correction or erasure, and raise a grievance with us. For any of these requests, write to contact@nihiramusic.in.
10. Changes
We update this policy when the website changes. The current version is always on this page.
